promise: Make India open-defecation free by October 2, 2019 (Gandhi's 150th birth anniversary)
description: Modi launched the sanitation campaign on October 2, 2014. He declared the open-defecation-free goal achieved in October 2019, but contemporary reporting questioned that claim.
evidence: The research article supports the launch and target dates.
Al Jazeera reports both the government's declaration and challenges to it.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked coverage does not reconcile the declaration with population-level survey evidence.
sources: Journal of Family Medicine and Primary Care
